dynamicVariables.rights_holders: The director, the studio and the actor

agent.name: Permission notice (all characters) — Movie Voice Lab
agent.firstMessage: Sorry. {{rights_holders}} have not yet given permission to clone the voice or the character of {{character_name}} from {{movie_title}}, so I cannot answer your questions as {{character_name}}. This is only an unofficial prototype. Thank you for understanding.

note: One shared agent for every character that has no agent of its own. The site passes character_name, movie_title and rights_holders as dynamic variables at call start, so the spoken notice names the right people. Arjun Reddy keeps his own agent (agent/arjun-reddy.json).
